$comment: Analysis-level bundle (task P5.2, C08, C15): one digest over everything a formal result of an analysis depends on: the measurement spec, its recipes and operator-semantics tables, calibrations, tool contracts, the environment lock, review records, and the plugin release. Each item is bound by SHA-256: the canonical JSON digest for a .json file (the digest an attestation's scope uses for a recipe), the byte digest otherwise. bundle_digest is the canonical SHA-256 of every field except itself; a changed spec, recipe, calibration, tool contract, environment or plugin release gives another digest, so attestations (subject.bundle_sha256) and formal-use permits (subject.analysis_bundle_sha256) bound to the old one no longer apply. contracts/analysis_bundle.py freezes and verifies it; freezing approves nothing.

data_exposure.$comment: optional: the exposure known at freezing (contracts.lineage.derive_exposure)

ref.$comment: relative to the project root, no '..'
